text:
Maya: Quick sync on the dense-mode vectors preview — QA flagged a few things: relevance badges disappearing at narrow widths, export label ambiguity, and screen reader focus landing on the close button. Screenshot attached.

design-bot: snapshot-5067 uploaded: https://ci/internal/5067/shot.png

Olivia: Re: badges — in dense mode the pill bg collapses into the row hover color. Propose a dedicated badge column (min 64px) and pill text #E5E7EB on dark to meet contrast.

Jamal: Front-end note: fixed column is doable. I'll add a CSS var --badge-column-width and collapse to an overflow menu under 480px. Will also ensure pill has 14px hit area.

Ankur: Accessibility: add aria-describedby for relevance pills with copy "Higher = more relevant" and role="status" for live updates. When sort changes, update an aria-live polite region: "Sorted by relevance, descending".

Samira: Export copy: current "Export vectors" is vague. Recommend primary "Download CSV" and a secondary dropdown: "Download NDJSON (for eval)" and "Download CSV (id,embedding,metadata)". Consider a gzip option for large exports: "NDJSON (.ndjson.gz)".

Olivia: Love the gzip option. Also show a sample header in the dropdown:
```
id,query_id,score,embedding_0,...,metadata.source,metadata.user
```
and a short tooltip: "CSV preserves column order; use NDJSON for newline-delimited pipelines."

Maya: Filename conventions asked by analytics: use vectors-<workspace>-YYYYMMDD[-suffix].(csv|ndjson.gz). Allow custom prefix in export modal and preview final name.

Jamal: I'll add format and compress params to the export API: format=csv|ndjson, compress=true|false, prefix=string. Default: csv+metadata, no compress. Backwards compatible.

Ankur: Keyboard: add D to download focused item, Shift+D for batch export. When preview opens, hint "Press D to download vectors for this item". Ensure focus is set to the preview title (initialFocus = '#preview-title') not the close button.

Olivia: I'll wire the keyboard hint into the small help pill. Also increase caret hit area on sort header to 14px and expose aria-sort on the header element.

Maya: Tiny UI nit — truncated metadata keys show no affordance. Add title attribute + hover tooltip and sr-only full text for screen readers.

Samira: UX question: when users pick NDJSON + gzip, should we auto-start download or show a generated artifact page with a link? Some exports can take minutes. For large requests we need an async job with notification.

Jamal: Good point. For >50k rows we'll enqueue export job and show progress toast: "Preparing export — we'll email you when ready" plus a download link in the console notifications panel. Small exports (<50k) download immediately.

Ankur: Make sure async completion updates aria-live: "Export ready: vectors-workspace-20260323.ndjson.gz" so AT users are notified. Also include a copy button for the filename/link.

Olivia: I'll push a mock that includes: badge column, pill color updates, split export button, filename preview input, NDJSON+gzip option, and keyboard hints. Will also add an a11y checklist to the PR: aria-sort, aria-live, initial focus, title attr for truncated cells, and keyboard shortcut docs.

Maya: Thanks — once PR is in we'll run a quick 5-user test focusing on export understandability and keyboard flow, then smoke on staging. :rocket:
